notes:
## New settings menu

Settings now use large full-screen category lists and separate pages. Up/down stays in the current page, left/right adjusts sliders, OK opens readable option lists, and Back restores the previous selection. Display, ambience and sound have their own pages. Custom remote navigation also works inside the remote editor and resumes after key learning.

## More TV platforms

Alongside Philips jointSPACE v6, local discovery and power control now include experimental adapters for **LG webOS, Samsung Tizen, Sony BRAVIA IP control and Roku TVs**, including compatible **TCL, Hisense and Roku-branded TVs**. Settings → Controls → TV guides each platform through its connection method. Existing Philips pairings are preserved.

Automatic TV wake is enabled after pairing. Automatic standby when the PC sleeps or shuts down remains a separate option, disabled by default. Canapey must be running.

**Compatibility depends on model, firmware and TV operating system.** TCL/Hisense Google TV and VIDAA are not supported by the Roku adapter. The new adapters have automated protocol and simulated UI coverage, but physical LG/Samsung/Sony/Roku TV behavior and Windows sleep/resume still require hardware validation. See [TV setup and limitations](https://github.com/DwennK/canapey-launcher/blob/v0.8.0/docs/TV.md).

## Maintenance

Compatible npm and Cargo updates include Vitest 5.1.0, vue-tsc 3.3.14, Rollup 4.67.4 and mdns-sd 0.21.7. Existing major-version constraints are preserved.

## Validation

Windows x64 CI passed: 119 JavaScript tests, 87 Rust tests (one live-network test intentionally ignored), Clippy and installer build. Companion interoperability checks passed for pairing, encrypted verification, commands, reconnection and revocation. Isolated Chrome checks covered settings navigation and simulated TV flows at desktop and mobile sizes.

## Install or update

Windows 11 x64 experimental release. Download the NSIS installer below, or use Canapey's signed 0.x update channel. Tauri update signatures verify updater artifacts; the installer is not Authenticode-signed. SHA256SUMS.txt is provided for the installer.
